Public Function Probe(ByVal path As String, ByVal reopen As Boolean) As String
    Dim wb As Object, ws As Object, r0 As Object, r1 As Object, r2 As Object, r3 As Object, r4 As Object, r5 As Object, r6 As Object, r7 As Object, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("Z1").Formula = "=ROWS(A1:XFD1048576)+ROWS(A:B)+ROWS(1:3)+ROWS(A1:B1048576)+ROWS(B2:C1048576)+ROWS(A1:XFD3)+ROWS(B2:XFD4)+ROWS(C5)"
    If reopen Then
        wb.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    End If
    Set r0 = ws.Range("A1:XFD1048576"): Set r1 = ws.Range("A:B"): Set r2 = ws.Range("1:3"): Set r3 = ws.Range("A1:B1048576"): Set r4 = ws.Range("B2:C1048576"): Set r5 = ws.Range("A1:XFD3"): Set r6 = ws.Range("B2:XFD4"): Set r7 = ws.Range("C5")
    ws.Rows(1).Insert
    s = "rows " & r0.Address(False, False) & " " & r1.Address(False, False) & " " & r2.Address(False, False) & " " & r3.Address(False, False) & " " & r4.Address(False, False) & " " & r5.Address(False, False) & " " & r6.Address(False, False) & " " & r7.Address(False, False) & " | " & ws.Range("Z2").Formula
    ws.Columns(1).Insert
    s = s & " || columns " & r0.Address(False, False) & " " & r1.Address(False, False) & " " & r2.Address(False, False) & " " & r3.Address(False, False) & " " & r4.Address(False, False) & " " & r5.Address(False, False) & " " & r6.Address(False, False) & " " & r7.Address(False, False) & " | " & ws.Range("AA2").Formula
    wb.Close False
    Probe = s
End Function
